sources.title: README.md · lightx2v/MiniMax-H3-Prompt-Rewriter-LoRA at main
sources.snippet: This project is developed by the LightX2V community to make local MiniMax-H3 prompt rewriting and audio-video generation easier and more efficient. It is built for the MiniMax-H3 audio-video generation model and fine-tuned from Qwen3.6-27B.

sources.title: MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA - Models
sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA An open, local prompt rewriter for text-to-audio-video (T2VA) generation with MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned as a LoRA adapter on top of Qwen3.6-27B. Generate the final audio-video with LightX2V.

sources.title: MiniMax-H3 Prompt Rewriter for ComfyUI - GitHub
sources.snippet: ComfyUI nodes for the LightX2V MiniMax-H3 T2VA Prompt Rewriter LoRA. A short prompt goes in; a structured, production-ready audio-video description for MiniMax-H3 comes out — entirely locally. Русская версия · Changelog The prompt may be in any language the base model reads; the rewrite comes back in English, which is what MiniMax-H3 expects.
